name: TRITON
description: TRITON is malware designed to manipulate industrial safety systems. TRITON has targeted Schneider Electric's Triconex safety instrumented system (SIS) controllers, reprogramming Tricon safety controllers.

name: INDUSTROYER2
description: INDUSTROYER2 is designed to target and manipulate protection relays used in electric transmission substations, capable of issuing unauthorized commands to protection relay devices.
